theurgical.definition: a. Of or pertaining to theurgy; magical.

theurgist.definition: n. One who pretends to, or is addicted to, theurgy.
theurgist.translation: n. 施妖术者, 法师

theurgy.definition:
n. the effect of supernatural or divine intervention in human affairs
n. white magic performed with the help of beneficent spirits (as formerly practiced by Neoplatonists)
theurgy.translation: n. 神力, 法术, 巫术, 妖术
